reviews.author: Michael Harrison
reviews.text: Full engine replacement on my Scion xB this week, and I got it back running great. Nice people, good prices, no frills. I don't live too close but I'd go back for more work.

reviews.author: Jairo Velasquez Rodriguez
reviews.text: I took my car in for a few repairs and they did a great job. The customer service was good and they didn’t take long to finish the work. I definitely recommend this place

reviews.author: Mitu Talukdar
reviews.text: Highly recommend Carfixed Auto Repair for anyone dealing with a warranty company claim. The team made the entire process easy and professional from start to finish. They worked directly with the warranty company, kept me updated during the repair, and completed the job quickly with quality workmanship. Excellent customer service, honest diagnostics, and experienced technicians. Whether it’s engine repair, transmission service, brakes, suspension, check engine light diagnostics, or maintenance, Carfixed handles the job the right way. It’s hard to find a trustworthy repair shop that stands behind their work, but Carfixed definitely does. Great local repair shop with reliable service and fair pricing.

reviews.author: Adem KARAKAYA
reviews.text: I had wheel balancing, tire rotation, and alignment done here. Overall, the pricing was reasonable and fair for the services provided. The staff were friendly and had great customer service, which made the whole experience smooth. I’m currently very satisfied with how my car feels after the service. The only downside is that they don’t provide a before-and-after alignment report, which would have been helpful. Aside from that, everything else was good and I would consider coming back.

reviews.author: Jonathan Nieves
reviews.text: Came here for the first time and right from the beginning they were very professional and understanding. I used my warranty and they delt with the calls and confirmations. I originally felt it might if been the alternator, and after they did a very thorough diagnostic of my vehicle, it was the starter and alternator. they voiced all concerns, and was very transparent how much everything would cost in the end. they were nice enough to wave certain fees to keep cost down and fixed my vehicle in a timely matter. They also explained if future issues did come up, they would check the vehicle and again, wave some fees for me (not always guaranteed, it is a business, but they were very understanding and professional the whole way through). Between the amazing service, explaining on how the warranties work, and the above class of service, I would highly recommend this shop to anyone. They didnt just have normal vehicles here, they also serviced high end vehicles as well(confirm your vehicle needs when calling, first). I will be returning for all of my future needs and anyone I know that also needs service. My car runs 100% better now and I cannot be more satisfied with this shop. Check them out and give this shop a chance. They won't let you down.

reviews.author: Anthony Fazzinga Jr.
reviews.text: This place is highly unprofessional and shady. I took my truck here to get diagnosed because it was stuck in drive and wouldn’t start. They used a wench on the back of my truck to get it off the tow truck. They caused damage on the back of my tailgate. Didn’t tell me about it till a week later. They sent me videos of them literally doing it, and yet they still refused to say it was their fault but got the damage fixed which shows they caused it. They were shady with the charges for the transmission work that was approved and paid for by my extended warranty. They tried charging me for the teardown fee which ended up being covered. They then tried charging me over $700 for shop supplies but never told me about it. After telling them I was getting the better business bureau and my attorney involved to inspect the shady antics they agreed to only charge me $187 for my deductible and shop supplies. They know they’re wrong. They put my battery back in place with a rusty bolt and my truck still isn’t driving correctly, it’s jerking and has braking sensor issues which I didn’t have before. The most unpleasant shady shop I’ve ever experienced. Don’t bring your vehicle here unless you want to be scammed! When I went to pick it up they had some random guy that must work for them at there other shop and the manager and owner was no where to be found. They have no backbone as men! Couldn’t face me because they know they messed up! They also put the wrong Coolant fluid into my vehicle which costed me $340 to get done somewhere else. They either deliberately did it or just plain stupid at their job. Don't trust these people, I paid the $187 and took it somewhere Professional!

reviews.author: Ahmer Mujtaba
reviews.text: ​What truly sets carfix apart is their commitment to honesty and customer satisfaction. I never felt pressured into unnecessary repairs, and they took the time to answer all my questions patiently. It's refreshing to find a car service center that you can genuinely trust.

reviews.text: For over a year, I have been seeking to have my rack and pinion replaced. Every mechanic I approached was reluctant to undertake the task due to its complexity and time-consuming nature. Fortunately, I discovered Carfixed Repair Shop. Mr. Zabir, the manager, was an absolute delight to work with. He conducted a thorough inspection of my vehicle, replaced the rack and pinion, and performed a tire rotation. Additionally, he addressed several minor dents and imperfections on the car's body. The level of customer service provided by Carfixed is truly exceptional. If you seek a reliable and professional establishment to rectify your automotive concerns, Carfixed is the ideal choice. Before commencing any work, they meticulously demonstrate the issues with your vehicle, empowering you to make informed decisions regarding the necessary repairs.

reviews.author: shafi khan
reviews.text: Although I rarely write negative reviews about businesses, I feel compelled to share my recent experience. I visited this shop a few days ago to have my tires replaced, but was dismayed to discover that I was given used tires and charged an exorbitant price of $60 for a used rim without any prior explanation of the cost. Initially, the shop told me that a 3% surcharge would be added if I paid with a card, but they ended up charging me 6% when it was time to pay, gradually increasing the total bill without my knowledge. This was an extremely unpleasant experience for me, especially because I own a business in the same area and always strive for transparency and honesty. The next day, I went to Firestone and found out the fair price for new tires, which further confirmed my disappointment with the tire shop's practices. As a new driver with my first car, I feel like the shop took advantage of me, and I strongly believe that businesses should operate with integrity and honesty.

reviews.author: Jacquelyn Greenberg
reviews.text: I have been using Carfixed for the past 2 years, and I am consistently impressed with their level of service. Most recently, I brought in my ecoboost mustang for an installation of summer tires and a transmission oil change, and as always, the team at Carfixed delivered exceptional results. Not only did they fix my car within 24 hours, but my transmission feels significantly better - much less laggy and sloppy. I appreciate how Carfixed always keeps me informed throughout the process and communicates well with me. Over the past 2 years, Carfixed has helped me out whenever my car was acting funny, and they have never let me down. Their prices are fair, their work is top-notch, and their customer service is unmatched. If you're looking for a reliable and efficient car service provider, look no further than Carfixed. I highly recommend them, and I will continue to be a loyal customer for years to come. Thanks again, Carfixed!
